newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sharp says 96/97 profit seen short of forecast.
newsitem.headline: Sharp says 96/97 profit seen short of forecast.

text.p: Sharp Corp said on Friday it was likely to post a parent current profit of about 72 billion yen in the year to March 31, 2.0 billion yen short of its previous forecast. It posted a parent current profit of 70.53 billion yen in 1995/96.
A Sharp spokesman said there were no large discrepancies between its business and the contents of a Nihon Keizai Shimbun report on Friday.
The Japanese business daily reported that the expected drop in the current profit was due to price falls in semiconductors such as flash memory chips.
Shares in Sharp closed Friday morning trade on the Tokyo Stock Exchange at 1,500, down 90 yen. The issue was the fifth largest percentage loser on the first section of TSE.
